metadata.logline: Following their illicit passion in the abandoned manor wing, Catherine negotiates Father Thomas's corrupt silence with territorial control—unaware that Agnes has walked in and witnessed their scandalous intimacy.
metadata.continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 49, where Father Thomas and Catherine sealed their covert alliance in the secluded wing; now, their secret affair deepens into political extortion before being shattered by an unexpected witness.

events.text: High overhead birds-eye shot looking straight down at the unkempt bed, where Catherine lies curled in a silk chemise against Father Thomas's bare chest.
Father Thomas lies flat on his back, breathless, while Catherine rests beside him, her fingers tracing across his bare skin.
Low-angle medium close-up on Catherine looking down adoringly into Father Thomas's face, a single candle flickering in the dark background.
"A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas."
events.speaker: CATHERINE

events.text: Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.
Close-up on Father Thomas turning his head toward her on the pillow, his voice raspy and dry.
"A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."
events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS

events.text: Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.
"Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."
events.speaker: CATHERINE

events.text: Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.
"Name your price."
events.speaker: CATHERINE

events.text: Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.
"The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."
events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS

events.text: Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.
"That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."
events.speaker: CATHERINE

events.text: Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.
"Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS

events.text: Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.
"Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
events.speaker: CATHERINE

events.text: Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.
"For as long as it holds."
events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS

events.text: Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.
"Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does."
events.speaker: CATHERINE

events.text: Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.
"I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again."
events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS

events.text: Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.
"In another room no one uses?"
events.speaker: CATHERINE

events.text: "Perhaps I like rooms no one uses."
events.speaker: FATHER THOMAS

events.text: Close-up profile as Catherine slides both hands into the dark hair at the back of his neck, pulling him closer.
"Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for."
events.speaker: CATHERINE

events.text: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas pulls Catherine into a fierce, suffocating embrace, burying his face in her neck while she clings to his broad shoulders.
Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.
Medium tracking shot following Agnes as she walks cautiously down the dimly lit stone corridor, holding a black iron lantern.
Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.
Over-the-shoulder shot behind Agnes as she stops dead in front of an open doorway, peering inside.
Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.
Tight close-up on Agnes's face, drained of all color, her eyes bulging in pure terror.
Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.
Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.
Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.
